title: Barnaby and the Moonbeam
description: A curious little owl tries to catch a dancing moonbeam on the forest floor before learning to appreciate it from above.
character_reference: a fluffy brown baby owl with huge amber eyes and speckled grey wing feathers

scenes.narration: Barnaby fluttered down from his high branch to chase a bright silver strip of moonlight resting on the forest floor. He reached out his talons to scoop it up.
scenes.visual: medium shot of a fluffy baby owl landing on dark soil trying to grab a bright patch of white moonlight with his claws

scenes.narration: Every time he pounced, his claws only grabbed cool green grass and soft dirt. The moonbeam slipped right through his feathers like water.
scenes.visual: close up of the confused little owl looking down at empty paws where a bright pool of light just vanished

scenes.narration: A gentle moth landed on his beak and whispered, You cannot hold a moonbeam in your paws, Barnaby. You have to look up to enjoy its beauty.
scenes.visual: macro shot of a tiny white moth resting on the beak of a wide-eyed baby owl surrounded by dark shadows

scenes.narration: Barnaby blinked, spread his speckled wings, and flew back up to his cozy treetop home. From high above, the silver light washed over the whole forest.
scenes.visual: action shot of the small owl taking flight upward toward glowing tree branches lit by silvery moonlight

scenes.narration: Sitting safely on his branch, he realized the moonlight wasn't meant to be caught. It was meant to guide everyone safely through the quiet night.
scenes.visual: peaceful medium shot of the owl perched on a high tree branch looking out at a vast silvery forest below

scenes.narration: He tucked his head beneath his wing and let the soft silver glow lull him into a deep, dreamless sleep. The night is full of quiet wonders.
scenes.visual: close up of the cute owl sleeping soundly with his head tucked under his fluffy wing in the cozy nest

scenes.narration: Some things are most magical when we just sit back and admire them. Follow along for more bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: serene view of a bright full moon shining brightly through quiet starry night clouds
